lines.differs: Remuneration is EUR 88,000 paid within 30 days, rather than USD 48,000 paid within 45 days.
Remuneration is EUR 88,000 rather than USD 71,000 under SOW-1; payment terms mention German tax reverse-charge.
Fixed fee of EUR 88,000 on milestone completion, rather than monthly timesheet-based invoicing.
Specifically grants a perpetual license to proprietary accelerator "PipeKit" instead of general pre-existing tools.
Explicitly licenses "PipeKit" rather than granting AtliQ a broad license over all Work Products.
Licenses proprietary tool "PipeKit" specifically, rather than general pre-existing materials and tools.
Applies a "contractual penalty (Vertragsstrafe)" rather than "liquidated damages," with similar 0.5% and 5% limits.
Penalty is 0.5% per week up to 5% per milestone, rather than 1% of Contract Value per day.
Penalty is 0.5% per week up to 5%, rather than 1% of affected milestone fees per week.
References German law principles (Kardinalpflicht) and unlimited liability for gross negligence, rather than standard liability exclusions.
Slight negligence cap is total contract value under German law, instead of two times the 12-month fees.
Slight negligence liability capped at total remuneration under German law, instead of a 12-month trailing fee cap.
Mutual indemnity is for any culpable breach, rather than specific exclusions like IP infringement or confidentiality.
Mutual indemnity for any culpable breach, rather than being limited to intellectual property infringement.
Indemnifies for any culpable breach, rather than being limited to confidentiality, IP infringement, or gross negligence.
Confidentiality survives for five years rather than three years, and lacks the explicit indefinite trade secret exception.
Specifies a five-year post-termination survival period; SIGNED has no explicit survival limit in the text.
Confidentiality obligation survives for five years after termination instead of two years.
References EU GDPR Module 2 SCCs for India transfers, rather than UK GDPR and the UK Addendum.
Requires an Art. 28 GDPR DPA and EU SCCs, rather than Indian DPDP Act 2023 compliance.
Governed by EU GDPR and SCCs for India transfers, rather than UAE/DIFC data protection laws.
Governed by German law with jurisdiction in Munich, rather than Ohio law and Franklin County courts.
Governed by German law (Munich jurisdiction) instead of England and Wales law (London courts).
Governed by German law in Munich courts, rather than Indian law with arbitration in New Delhi.
